7. The radioactive decay of rubidium-87, , into strontium-87, , is used to date rocks. The rocks do not contain strontium when they are formed.

a Identify the type of decay. [1]

b Explain why the beta spectrum led to the postulate of the neutrino. [2]

c Given masses of Rb-87 and Sr-87 and decay constant 4.50×10^-19 s^-1, determine rock age. [3]

d.i Use binding-energy graph to identify feature justifying short range of strong nuclear force. [1]

d.ii Given mass of Rb-87 is 86.91 u, calculate its binding energy in MeV. [2]
